text: I kept the tally-rolls and Sign-counts for the Assembly's record office before my role was ended.
My access to the record office was revoked during the reorganization that followed the Turning.
Officially, my position no longer exists, and my clan-name was struck from the tally-rolls.
I retained partial copies of many tally-records and Sign-sequences from before my removal.
Some of those records are inconsistent with the version of the Turning told today.
Nara Snana still remembers ritual sequences I once helped tally for the festival calendar.
She does not ask why I am no longer present in official records.
Tarek Sabha avoids discussing the reorganization period entirely.
Certain tally-pages from the Great Bath and Assembly records are missing in identical patterns.
This suggests coordinated removal, not random loss.
Sena Sabha once said people remember what they are allowed to remember.
I think she is closer to the truth than she realizes.
The abandoned house I live in was not always abandoned.
It was reassigned after my removal from the record office.
No official explanation was ever given.
Ikan Sabha sometimes walks near the house but has not entered.
Fen Bhata once approached the Old Canal Bed near here during a scouting trip.
He left quickly, though nothing there moved.
Tally-records I still possess reference a Citadel wing that no longer matches the current structure.
Some Sign-sequences were deliberately recopied differently between the two versions I hold.
Kalen Mudra notices structural changes in the brickwork that match my records.
Ren Mudra notices Sign-style discontinuities that match the same period.
Neither of them has access to the full administrative removal records that I do.
I do not believe the Turning was a single event.
I believe it was used, after the fact, to justify a broader reorganization of who controlled records and grain.
Some knowledge was removed in the name of stability.
Some of that knowledge is still physically present in this town, in walls and pastures and canal beds.
But it is no longer officially recognized.
I have stopped trying to restore everything.
I only preserve what still survives contact with reality.
